title: celmisia spectabilis subsp. magnifica
intro: Celmisia spectabilis subsp. magnifica, commonly known as the Giant White Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Celmisia spectabilis subsp. magnifica include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential remedy for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
